changes.comment: Rebuild Spell on one ordered engine: checks and transforms run in chain order, definitions record every built-in constraint, object derivations reject runtime behavior, and duplicate APIs are removed (merge, defaults, partialDefaults, requiredFields, optionalFields, label, tolerate(), SyncParsable, raw-literal unions, fromDefinition). Issue codes unify under invalid_format and invalid_discriminator. See docs/spell/migration.md.
